name: Occupancy Clustering
definition: A neighborhood-based global clustering algorithm applied to the multiscale occupancy grid of Instant-NGP to identify coherent clusters of occupancy. It assumes that the relevant scene consists of one coherent volume of density, and clusters not coherent with this core are identified as artifacts.
summary: Occupancy Clustering removes floating artifacts from NeRFs by clustering and pruning volumetric regions structurally severed from the main scene geometry, preserving sparse but connected structures.
